title: Browser gate servers start on free ports; a fixed-port gate guards it
changelog: **Gate servers on free ports (v59.70):** every browser gate and dump script that starts a local server now asks the OS for a free port (`freePort()` / `startLocalServer(0)`, which reads the real port from the server's ready line) unless its `*_PORT` variable is set, so two gates or two worktrees running at once no longer collide on a hard-coded port. ci-qa-pipeline-contract-check replaces its unique-default-port rule with a scan that fails on a fixed default port (`PORT || 1234`, `startLocalServer(1234`, a literal `127.0.0.1:1234`) and on a server-owning browser gate without a free port.

qa.text: v59.70: no script under scripts/ or scripts/lib/ (except start-local-node's manual dev-server default 8765) has a fixed default server port, and every server-owning browser gate uses freePort() or startLocalServer(0)

note: change-only (no P): 2nd batch A item (3), committed in f13451be
